statements.t: “In HCM, positive CIRRUS-HCM Part D results and our JCI Insight publication reinforce the differentiated profile of EDG-7500, and we expect to initiate our Phase 3 trial by year-end 2026.
CIRRUS-HCM was designed to inform a Phase 3 trial, which the Company expects to initiate by the end of 2026.
The Company also published the preclinical pharmacologic profile of EDG-7500, targeting the regulatory light chain, in JCI Insight , which can be found here .
